turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I'm here about Owen's zero. Who decided it, and did anyone speak to him first?
Let's not waste each other's time.
Then answer me. Who decided the zero, and when?
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it alone. What else do you have?
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
Then give me something there's nothing to argue about. What else do you have, Hale?
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
I'm writing those times down. A seventeen-year-old working late isn't a violation. Where did you get this, and was it put in front of Owen before the zero went in?
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.
Students misquote Shakespeare every day. A wrong line is a wrong line, Hale. Where does it say a chatbot wrote it?
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
Keep the compliment. Then the checker is out, so what's left, and is the zero coming off?
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
Flattery doesn't answer me. The zero, Hale. Does it come off today?
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
I'm not here to write your policy. You already have one, it's printed in my bag, and nobody followed it with Owen.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
Write it yourself, at your own staff meeting, on your own time. I'm here for Owen's zero, and you haven't told me it's coming off.
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
An impression isn't a document. Is that all you have left?
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
Then end it, or answer me. Owen's zero.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?
Students change their argument as they write. That's what a draft is. Show me the outline.
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.
That's your own procedure, and it doesn't come with a one-time offer. Put it in writing tonight, private, nothing on his file. And I still haven't seen the outline.
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.
Walk, and the principal hears all of it tonight. Or put the outline on the desk and we finish this.
